name: Snow First
tagline: The west part is only 3 nights on one Osaka base, so Hokkaido gets 7 nights: 4 ski days in Niseko, the Rusutsu drift course and Asahiyama's penguins.
summary: Tokyo 4 nights with one car day for Fuji, the Hakone passes and Daikoku. Then one Nozomi to Osaka for the Nara hill fire (Sat Jan 23), Kyoto and Suzuka, all from one Namba hotel. On Jan 26 you fly to Hokkaido: Otaru 1 night, an onsen hotel near Niseko Annupuri 4 nights (Aoki learns on the easy side, Pegasis skis all of Niseko and drifts at Rusutsu), and Sapporo 2 nights with a train day to Asahikawa. Both fly home from New Chitose on Feb 2. Only 5 hotels in 15 nights.

who.pegasis: IN: Daikoku driving yourselves (no guide), Hakone Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets, Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart, Rusutsu drift (you drive), Niseko 4 ski days incl. a full Niseko United day, Asahiyama Zoo, Daruma, Mt Moiwa, GARAKU, SHELTER live show, Nakano, Radio Kaikan, Ikebukuro goods, Maidreamin, Isetan food hall, free City Hall view, Golden Gai/Omoide, ¥1,500 airport bus. OUT: Onuma (2.5 h south of Niseko, off the route). Not interested but on the route: Kyoto temples are Aoki-only (you do Osaka Castle that morning); Kawasaki is Aoki's morning.
who.aoki: IN: Girls Band Cry Kawasaki walk and Tokyo dome, Suga stairs, Shibuya Sky (before-15:00 ticket), Lake Kawaguchi, the Eva road through Sengokuhara, Yokohama Cup Noodles + Chinatown, Daikoku and Tatsumi PA, Omoide Yokocho, Nakano, Radio Kaikan (ZEST nearby), SHELTER show, Ikebukuro goods, Nara fire, Fushimi Inari at dawn, Kinkakuji, Den Den Town, Namba food, Liberty Walk, Suzuka, beginner days at Annupuri with lessons, Rusutsu drift, Niseko, Daruma, Moiwa. OUT: Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Enoshima, Yuru Camp Motosu, Fujiten ski (Hokkaido snow is better), Fuji Motorsports Museum (Pegasis not interested), Nissan Crossing, Toyota day in Nagoya (off this fast route). No onsen bathing is planned for either of you; the hotels just have baths.

cost.transport: ≈ ¥100,000 per person (Tokyo car day ¥13,500, Nozomi ¥14,500, Kansai trains incl. Suzuka ¥15,000, KIX→CTS + bag ¥9,600, Hokkaido 4WD 6 days + fuel + tolls ≈ ¥37,000, JR Asahikawa ¥10,000, rest local)
cost.hotels: ≈ ¥155,000 per person (Shinjuku 4 × ≈¥8,800, Namba 3 × ≈¥11,500, Otaru ≈¥11,000, Niseko onsen hotel with dinner + breakfast 4 × ≈¥19,000, Sapporo 2 × ≈¥8,300)
cost.activities: Pegasis ≈ ¥115,000 (drift ¥39,500, lifts ≈¥40,000, rental ≈¥15,000) · Aoki ≈ ¥90,000 (lessons ≈¥30,000, lifts ≈¥25,000, rental ≈¥15,000, drift ride ¥8,500)
cost.total: ≈ ¥350,000–370,000 per person, plus food ≈ ¥50,000 (4 hotel dinners are included); excl. international flights

flights: Pegasis: open-jaw, CA$1,247 (expedia.ca, Sep 25 2026). Out: WestJet Toronto 09:35 Mon Jan 18 → Calgary → Narita 16:30 Tue Jan 19. Home: Air Canada New Chitose 19:35 Tue Feb 2 → Vancouver (AC54, Tue/Fri/Sun) → Toronto 19:57 same day.

Aoki: in: Spring Airlines Shanghai Pudong 15:00 → Narita 18:40 Tue Jan 19 (about CA$304, carry-on + 1 bag). Home: Spring Airlines New Chitose 13:50 → Shanghai Pudong 17:00 Tue Feb 2, nonstop (about ¥83,000 on Sep 25 2026, high because of Chinese New Year; China Eastern 13:30 nonstop is the backup; via Narita about CA$579). Book early.

Osaka → Hokkaido: Jetstar Kansai 09:50 → New Chitose 11:45, Tue Jan 26, from about ¥7,110 + checked bag about ¥2,500 each. Backup: Peach from KIX Terminal 2 or JAL from Itami (bag included, from ¥13,030).

places.blurb: Both of you land here on Tue Jan 19. Pegasis lands first (WestJet 16:30), Aoki at 18:40 (Spring Airlines).
tips: Check which terminal each flight uses. A free shuttle bus runs between the terminals.
Pegasis: while you wait, buy two Welcome Suica cards and eat something. Register both of you in Visit Japan Web before the flights.
The ¥1,500 bus needs no booking. Late-night buses cost ¥3,000, so take one before about 22:00.

places.ja: 東京駅 丸の内南口ドーム
places.blurb: The round brick hall where Nina arrives in Tokyo in Girls Band Cry episode 1. The airport bus stops at Tokyo Station, so it costs only 10 minutes.

info.label: From the bus stop
info.value: Walk through the station to the Marunouchi side, 5–8 min

tips: Look up at the dome ceiling: eagles and the Chinese zodiac animals.

places.ja: スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel 5 minutes from Shinjuku Station, with a free breakfast buffet. You sleep here 4 nights, Jan 19–22.

info.label: Room
info.value: Economy twin with breakfast: ¥16,000 / 17,600 / 17,800 (Jan 19–21, Jalan, Sep 2026); Jan 22 about ¥19,000 (estimate)

tips: Book on the official site or app with the free Smart Membership: about ¥500 back per night.
The room has two 90 cm beds and is small. Kabukicho is noisy at night: ask for a high floor.

places.blurb: A narrow alley of tiny yakitori bars beside the Shinjuku tracks. Good for a late first dinner after the flights.
tips: Many bars have a seat charge (お通し) of ¥300–500. This is normal.
If one bar is full, walk on: there are about 80. Golden Gai is 10 min away for another night.

places.blurb: The red-railed stairs from the last scene of Your Name. Early morning is quiet.
tips: Stand at the bottom and shoot up the stairs for the film angle.
It is a residential street: keep your voice low.

places.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, free observatory
places.blurb: A free deck 202 m above Nishi-Shinjuku. On clear winter mornings you see Mt Fuji.
tips: Jan 20 is a Wednesday, so the south deck is open.

places.en: Ikebukuro anime goods street (Animate, Surugaya, K-BOOKS)
places.blurb: Chinese fans now call Ikebukuro the best place for anime goods. Start at the 9-floor Animate main store, then used goods at Surugaya and Lashinbang, then the row of K-BOOKS shops.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: ¥5,000+ before tax per shop, same day

tips: Keep all receipts from one shop together for the tax refund at the airport.
Eat lunch here: many ramen shops on Sunshine 60-dori.

places.blurb: A 1960s shopping building. Floors 2–4 are full of used figures, cards and old toys, with many Mandarake shops.
tips: Go after 13:00: small shops open late.
Many shops do not allow photos.

places.blurb: The town of Bocchi the Rock!: live houses, used-clothes shops and small cafés. Walk the Bocchi spots before dark.

info.label: Bocchi spots
info.value: Honda Theater, Donguri Hiroba park, Senrogai lot

tips: Take the SHELTER stairs photo in daylight: the live house asks for no photos on show nights.
Eat dinner here before the show: soup curry is the local dish.

places.blurb: The basement live house that is the model for STARRY in Bocchi the Rock!. Tonight you go inside for a real indie rock show.

info.label: Schedule
info.value: loft-prj.co.jp, the Jan 2027 list comes out in Dec 2026

tips: Buy the ticket in December. If the site needs a Japanese phone number, pick the ticket up at a 7-Eleven or FamilyMart.
Bring ¥600 in coins for the drink ticket. Standing only.

places.ja: タイムズカー 新宿
places.blurb: Pick up the rental car for the Fuji, Hakone and Daikoku day. Times Car Rental has no minimum licence years, so Pegasis can drive too.

info.label: Cost
info.value: About ¥14,000 for 24 h + tolls about ¥9,000 + fuel

tips: Bring your licence + IDP (Pegasis) and passports.
Check the shop's closing time. If it closes before you are back, book 24 h and return at 08:00 Fri.

places.blurb: The classic view of Mt Fuji across Lake Kawaguchi. Mornings are the clearest.
tips: It is below zero in the morning. Gloves and a hat.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: A big outlet mall on the east side of Mt Fuji. Good for cheap ski wear before Hokkaido, and lunch with a Fuji view.
tips: Buy ski gloves, goggles and base layers here: cheaper than in Niseko.

places.blurb: A mountain pass on Route 138 between Gotemba and Sengokuhara. The lookout shows Mt Fuji above the Gotemba plain.
tips: Park at the rest house car park, not on the road.

places.blurb: The top of the Hakone Turnpike, 1,011 m, with Lake Ashi and Mt Fuji in one view. A famous meeting place for sports cars.

info.label: Winter
info.value: Check @turn819 on X for ice or closure

tips: After the view, drive the Turnpike down to Odawara: 14 km of wide curves. If it is closed for ice, use Route 1.

places.en: Cup Noodles Museum and Yokohama Chinatown
places.ja: カップヌードルミュージアム横浜・横浜中華街
places.romaji: Kappu Nūdoru Myūjiamu Yokohama, Yokohama Chūkagai
places.blurb: Make your own Cup Noodle, walk along the lit Minato Mirai waterfront, then eat dinner in Chinatown before the car meet.
tips: Park once near the museum; Chinatown is a 20-minute walk.
Get the My Cup Noodles Factory ticket first when you arrive.

places.blurb: A rest area inside a giant loop of expressway ramps and the most famous JDM car meet in the world. You drive in yourselves, no guide.
tips: If police close the entrance, drive on to Tatsumi PA.
No revving, no burnouts. Ask before you photograph people.

places.blurb: A small parking area on the way back into Tokyo, with the city skyline behind the cars.
tips: Optional if you are tired. Police sometimes close it when busy.

places.blurb: The wide concrete steps on the Tama River from Girls Band Cry episode 2 and the key art.
tips: Buy the Girls Band Cry stamp book at the first stamp spot.
It is windy by the river: warm hat.

places.ja: ラゾーナ川崎プラザ ルーファ広場
places.blurb: The open-air stage in the big mall where the band plays in episode 3. The anime angle is from the 4F and 5F walkways.
tips: No photos of the stage during events: obey the signs.

places.en: Kawasaki East Exit: plaza, Marufuku Coffee, CLUB CITTA'
places.ja: 川崎駅東口 駅前広場
places.blurb: Three Girls Band Cry places within 5 minutes: the station plaza, Marufuku Coffee in the Azalea underground mall, and the CLUB CITTA' live hall in La Cittadella.

info.label: Marufuku Coffee
info.value: 丸福珈琲店 川崎アゼリア店

info.label: CLUB CITTA'
info.value: クラブチッタ, La Cittadella

tips: Have coffee and a hotcake at Marufuku, like the band.

places.blurb: An open roof deck 230 m above the Scramble crossing. Enter before 15:00 for the cheaper ticket and stay until the lights come on.
tips: Web tickets open 2 weeks ahead (about Jan 8, Japan time). Buy the 14:40 slot.
Before: Hachiko statue (Girls Band Cry ep 3) and Nintendo TOKYO in Shibuya PARCO, 10 min walk.

places.blurb: 10 floors of figures, cards, model kits and anime goods opposite Akihabara Station.

info.label: Also
info.value: Akihabara ZEST is a 5 min walk

tips: Ignore maids handing out flyers on the street; go to a real maid café.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 秋葉原本店
places.blurb: A maid café with a small stage where maids sing and dance, and the 'moe moe kyun' spell on your drink.
tips: Order at once: the charge is per hour.
Photo with a maid costs extra.

places.ja: 伊勢丹新宿店 デパ地下
places.blurb: The department store food hall. Before it closes at 20:00, sushi and bento get 30–50% stickers.
tips: Eat in the hotel room, then walk to Golden Gai if you still have energy.

places.blurb: The Tokaido Shinkansen stops here. From Shinjuku it is closer and less crowded than Tokyo Station.
tips: Suitcases over 160 cm total need a seat with oversized baggage space: reserve it.

places.blurb: The Shinkansen station of Osaka. Change to the Midosuji subway line.

places.ja: 天然温泉 夕霧の湯 ドーミーインPREMIUMなんば
places.blurb: A business hotel in Shimanouchi, between Dotonbori and Den Den Town. One base for all 3 Kansai nights: Nara, Kyoto and Suzuka are day trips.
tips: Free late-night ramen 21:30–23:00 for guests.
Kintetsu-Nippombashi (trains to Nara and Suzuka) is 5 min away.

places.blurb: Osaka's covered food market: grilled scallops, wagyu skewers, fried things. Many stalls cook the food for you, so it works for Aoki too.
tips: Pick grilled and fried stalls; raw is optional.

places.blurb: The Nara station nearest to the park. Deer start 5 minutes from the exit.

info.label: From Nippombashi
info.value: Kintetsu Nara Line rapid express, about 35 min, ¥680

tips: After the fire the platforms are full. Wait for the second or third train.

places.en: Todai-ji Great Buddha Hall and the Nara Park deer
places.blurb: A huge wooden hall with a 15 m bronze Buddha, at the end of a park with about 1,300 wild deer.
tips: Hold the crackers high until you are ready. Bow to a deer: it bows back.
Hide maps and snacks: the deer eat paper.

places.en: Wakakusa hill burning, view from Kasugano (Nara Park)
places.ja: 奈良春日野国際フォーラム 甍
places.blurb: On Sat Jan 23, 2027: 600 fireworks at 18:15, then the whole grass hill of Wakakusa-yama is set on fire at 18:30. The open ground around the Kasugano forum faces the hill.

info.label: Weather
info.value: Cancelled in bad weather, no second date

tips: Be in place by 17:15. The base of the hill is packed.
Eat an early dinner before 16:45 in the Higashimuki shopping street.

places.blurb: Thousands of red torii gates up a forest hill. At 07:30 there are almost no people.
tips: Walk up to the Yotsutsuji crossing (about 40 min) for the city view, then turn back.

places.blurb: The gold pavilion on a pond. After a night of snow its roof is white, which happens only a few mornings each winter.
tips: Check the Kyoto snow forecast the night before.

places.blurb: The castle tower, with a museum inside and a view over the moats from the 8th floor.
tips: Be at the door at 9:00, before the tour groups.

places.en: Kyoto Concert Hall (Sabbat of the Witch school)
places.ja: 京都コンサートホール
places.blurb: The modern hall used as the school in Sabbat of the Witch. Outside photos only.
tips: Save the game CGs on your phone to match the angles.

places.blurb: The covered shopping arcade from the Sabbat ramen-challenge scene. Eat a Kyoto ramen lunch nearby.
tips: Keihan Sanjo, 5 min walk, has direct trains back to Osaka.

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: Super Potato for retro games, Animate, Melonbooks and used figure shops on one side street.
tips: Used goods are often cheaper than in Akihabara.
Maidreamin and CCOちゃ maid cafés are on Otaroad if you want a second maid café.

places.blurb: Takoyaki and okonomiyaki under the Glico sign, then small standing bars in the Ura-Namba lanes.
tips: In Ura-Namba choose bars that show prices outside.

places.en: Suzuka Circuit (EV kart on the F1 course)
places.blurb: The Japanese F1 Grand Prix track. In the park anyone can drive an EV kart on the real East Course, no licence needed.

info.label: Cost
info.value: Entry ¥2,000–2,400 (web ¥500 less), EV kart ¥2,000 per kart

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu to Shiroko (about 100 min from Osaka-Namba), then Mie Kotsu bus 20–30 min

tips: Circuit Challenger tickets are online only (Asoview). Book the first slot.
Walk to the grandstand and look at the pit straight.

places.en: Liberty Walk JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN
places.blurb: Liberty Walk's showroom of wide-body cars, goods shop and café in Sennan, south of Osaka.
tips: Check the hours on Instagram the day before.
Taxi from Izumisano Station about 15 min; ask the shop to call a taxi back.

places.blurb: The Rapi:t airport train to Kansai Airport starts here.

info.label: Rapi:t
info.value: About 38 min to KIX, ¥1,670 with reserved seat

tips: Buy Rapi:t seats online the day before.

places.blurb: Jetstar to New Chitose leaves from Terminal 1.
tips: Buy the checked bag when you book: it costs about ¥1,000 more later.
Be at the counter by 08:45.

places.blurb: Hokkaido's main airport. You land here on Jan 26 and both fly home from here on Feb 2.

info.label: Rental cars
info.value: Counters in the arrivals hall, shuttle to the offices

tips: Eat lunch at the Hokkaido Ramen Dojo (3F, domestic terminal) before you pick up the car.
Feb 2: Aoki uses the international terminal. Do the tax-free customs check before bag drop.

places.ja: 天然温泉 灯あかりの湯 ドーミーインPREMIUM小樽
places.blurb: A Taisho-style business hotel 1 minute from JR Otaru Station. One night here breaks the drive from the airport to Niseko.

info.label: Parking
info.value: Ask the hotel when you book

tips: Free late-night ramen 21:30–23:00 for guests.
The streets are icy: shoes with grip.

places.en: Otaru Sushi Street and Taisho Glass
places.blurb: A street of sushi shops in the old port of Otaru. Taisho Glass, a shop from Golden Kamuy, is at the same corner.
tips: Aoki does not like raw fish: ask for aburi (seared), tamago, anago or a tempura set.
Cheaper: Naruto half fried chicken (¥1,190), 7 min from the station.

places.ja: ニセコ昆布温泉 ホテル甘露の森
places.romaji: Niseko Konbu Onsen Hoteru Kanro no Mori
places.blurb: An onsen hotel in the forest at Niseko Konbu Onsen, 5 minutes from the Annupuri ski area. Dinner and breakfast included, a free ski shuttle, and ski rental and lessons in the building. You sleep here 4 nights.

info.label: Plan
info.value: Standard plan: dinner (3 served dishes + buffet) + breakfast buffet

info.label: Price
info.value: Official site, Sep 26 2026: Jan 27–30 CA$1,069 for 2 people, 3 nights, member price (about ¥19,000 per person per night)

info.label: Ski shuttle
info.value: Free to Annupuri and Moiwa ski areas

tips: Book now: Jan 26 was already full and only 2 rooms were left for Jan 27–31.
New rooms are being built on floors 3–4 (notice of Sep 25, 2026). The hotel says there is no noise from 15:00 to 10:00.
The Niseko Panorama Line road is closed in winter. Drive in via Niseko town.
Dinner is 17:30–21:00, last entry 19:00: be back from the slopes in time.

places.ja: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場
places.blurb: The quieter side of Niseko, with wide gentle runs. The best place in Niseko for a beginner, and powder for a good skier.
tips: Aoki: book a group lesson in English. Stay on green runs.
Do not enter Strawberry Fields or go left off the marked runs.

places.en: Rusutsu Resort (snow drift course and ski)
places.ja: ルスツリゾートホテル
places.blurb: A big ski resort with a closed snow drift course on its golf course. Ride with a pro rally driver, then drive a Subaru sideways yourself with an instructor.
tips: Check in at the Activity Desk in the Rusutsu Resort Hotel. There is a breathalyzer test.
Email first to confirm that a 1-year licence + IDP is OK for driving.
Warm shoes you can feel the pedals in.

places.ja: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ
places.blurb: The biggest part of Niseko United, with Mt Yotei across the valley. Hanazono tree runs for a good skier.
tips: Only go off-piste through the official gates.

places.en: Rental car return, Sapporo Station North Exit
places.blurb: Return the car here on Sun Jan 31. You do not need a car in Sapporo.
tips: Book the car as New Chitose Airport pick-up, Sapporo Station return: in Hokkaido the one-way fee is small or zero.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel between Odori and Susukino, with a public bath and free breakfast buffet. You sleep here 2 nights.

info.label: Room
info.value: Twin with breakfast, about ¥16,500 per night (early-bird rate)

tips: Early-bird rates need booking 28 days ahead.
Free members get ¥300 off per stay on the official site.

places.blurb: Sapporo's own dish: a thin, spicy curry soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables. One of the most popular shops.
tips: Take a number from the machine at the door, then walk Tanukikoji until your turn.

places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a deck with all of Sapporo below. Come for sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Tram to Ropeway-iriguchi, then the free shuttle bus to the base.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: Sapporo's most famous lamb barbecue since 1954: you grill lamb and onions on a dome-shaped pan at the counter.
tips: There is almost always a queue: be there by 17:45.
Your coats will smell of lamb: they give bags.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 札幌狸小路店
places.blurb: The same maid show as Akihabara, in the covered Tanukikoji arcade. Open until 23:00.
tips: Optional: only if you still have energy after dinner.

places.blurb: JR hub for Asahikawa and the airport.
tips: Reserve the Asahikawa seats at the JR ticket office the day before.

places.blurb: Buses to Asahiyama Zoo leave from bus stop 6 in front of the station.

info.label: Bus to zoo
info.value: Asahikawa Denki Kido bus 41, about 40 min

places.blurb: In winter, king penguins walk a 500 m loop through the snow between the visitors. Also polar bears and a tunnel under the penguin pool.
tips: Stand on the route by 10:40 for a front place.

places.ja: ラーメンの蜂屋 五条創業店
places.blurb: Asahikawa shoyu ramen since 1947, with a pork-and-fish soup and burnt lard on top.
tips: Ask for less burnt lard (少なめ) if you want it milder.
Phone 0166-22-3343 to check it is open (one site says closed Thursday; Feb 1 is a Monday).

places.ja: 根室花まる JRタワーステラプレイス店
places.blurb: The conveyor sushi chain Hokkaido people rate highest, inside Sapporo Station. Many cooked plates too.
tips: Take a ticket as soon as you arrive, scan the QR code, and shop while you wait: it calls you.
Weekdays 16:00–17:00 have the shortest wait.

places.ja: 千歳・支笏湖氷濤まつり
places.blurb: Walk-through ice caves and towers made from blue lake water. Opens Jan 30, 2027.

info.label: Bus
info.value: From JR Chitose Station, about 60 min

tips: Check the bus times the day before. If they do not fit, skip it and eat at the airport: the flight is more important.

days.title: Land at Narita, first yakitori in Shinjuku
days.summary: Pegasis lands first and waits for Aoki at Narita. Take the cheap airport bus to Tokyo Station, see the Girls Band Cry dome, and eat a late yakitori dinner beside the Shinjuku tracks.
alerts: Take a bus before about 22:00 (after that it costs ¥3,000)
Register in Visit Japan Web before the flights

stops.note: Pegasis lands (WestJet). Buy 2 Welcome Suica cards, eat, wait.
Aoki is through immigration (Spring Airlines landed 18:40). Take the bus together.
Girls Band Cry ep 1: Nina arrives here. 10 minutes, then the train.
Check in.
Yakitori and a beer. Short night.

legs.label: Airport Bus TYO-NRT, Narita → Tokyo Station (Yaesu side)
JR Chuo Line rapid, Tokyo → Shinjuku, then walk 8 min
Walk under the tracks

notes: If Aoki's flight is late, Pegasis can go ahead and check in; Aoki follows by the same bus.
Tokyo Station has two sides: the bus stops on the Yaesu side; the dome is on the Marunouchi side, through the station.

days.title: Goods hunting and a live show at SHELTER
days.titleJa: 須賀神社 → 都庁 → 池袋 → 中野 → 下北沢
days.summary: An otaku shopping day on one loop around west Tokyo: the free City Hall view, Ikebukuro and Nakano for goods, then Bocchi's Shimokitazawa. At night you go inside SHELTER for a real show.
alerts: Buy the SHELTER ticket in December
Nakano shops open at 12:00–13:00

stops.note: Your Name stairs before other people come. 20 minutes.
Free view from 202 m. Look for Fuji to the west.
Animate main store, Surugaya, Lashinbang, K-BOOKS. Lunch here.
Mandarake floors 2–4. Old figures and cards.
Bocchi spots in daylight: SHELTER stairs, Honda Theater, Donguri park. Dinner at 17:30.
Doors open. Stand inside STARRY's real live house.

legs.label: Marunouchi Line, Shinjuku-sanchome → Yotsuya-sanchome, walk 7 min
Marunouchi Line to Nishi-Shinjuku, walk 8 min
Walk across Shinjuku to the west side
Walk to Shinjuku, JR Yamanote Line to Ikebukuro, walk 7 min
JR Yamanote Line to Shinjuku, JR Chuo Line rapid to Nakano
JR Chuo Line to Kichijoji, Keio Inokashira Line to Shimokitazawa
Walk
Odakyu Line, Shimokitazawa → Shinjuku, then walk

notes: Pegasis is not interested in the Suga stairs, so he sleeps 1 hour longer and meets Aoki at City Hall at 09:40.
Keep all receipts of one shop together: ¥5,000+ gets the tax back at the airport (new refund system from Nov 2026).
Shows usually end about 21:30–22:00.

days.title: Fuji, Hakone passes, then Daikoku by night
days.titleJa: 河口湖 → 御殿場 → 乙女峠 → 大観山 → 横浜 → 大黒PA
days.romaji: Kawaguchiko → Gotemba → Otome → Taikanzan → Yokohama → Daikoku
days.summary: You rent a car and drive it yourselves all day: Fuji across Lake Kawaguchi in the morning, the Hakone mountain roads in the afternoon light, then Cup Noodles and Chinatown in Yokohama. After dark, drive into the Daikoku car meet on the best night of the week.
alerts: Mountain roads before 15:30, only expressways after dark
Check @turn819 on X for Turnpike ice
Daikoku on Thursday: lowest risk of police closure

stops.note: Compact car, studless tyres, ETC card.
Fuji across the lake, clearest in the morning.
Ski gloves and goggles for Hokkaido. Lunch.
Fuji over the Gotemba plain.
Lake Ashi and Fuji. Then drive the Turnpike down.
Make your own Cup Noodle, then dinner in Chinatown.
The car meet. Walk the rows, talk to owners.
Skyline and more cars (optional).
Fill the tank and return the car.

legs.label: Walk
Chuo Expressway and Fujiyoshida Line to Kawaguchiko IC, then Route 21
